Tests of network measures

Source: R/test_measures.R
test_measures.Rd

These functions conduct tests of any network-level statistic:

  • test_random() performs a conditional uniform graph (CUG) test of a measure against a distribution of measures on random networks of the same dimensions.

  • test_configuration() performs a CUG test against a distribution of measures on random networks that preserve the degree sequence of the original network.

  • test_permutation() performs a quadratic assignment procedure (QAP) test of a measure against a distribution of measures on permutations of the original network. Each permutation keeps the node attributes and the changes of a diffusion, so a measure can read the times of adoption. For a null that rewires the network, see netdiffuseR::struct_test().

Usage

test_random(.data, FUN, ..., times = 1000, control = list())

test_configuration(.data, FUN, ..., times = 1000, control = list())

test_permutation(.data, FUN, ..., times = 1000, control = list())

Arguments

.data

A manynet-consistent network (see manynet::as_tidygraph()), or a list of such networks. When a list is supplied the model is fit jointly; graphs missing any predictor are dropped with a warning.

FUN

A graph-level statistic function to test.

...

Additional arguments to be passed on to FUN, e.g. the name of the attribute.

times

Integer. Number of permutations for the null distribution. 1000 is the default; publication-ready work usually needs 1000-10000.

control

The controls of the simulations, as the result of control_mrqap() or a named list of its arguments, such as list(ncores = 4, seed = 1). A test reads ncores, strategy, and seed, and leaves the other controls alone, so that the controls of a model can be given to a test whole. ncores is generally useful only when times > 1000. A control that is not named keeps its default, or the value set with control_mrqap(..., persist = TRUE), and the result records the controls that it used as control. See control_mrqap() for each control and its default.

Value

A network_test, which print(), tidy(), and glance() report. It holds the observed statistic in testval, the statistics of the simulations in testdist, and the share of these at or below the observed statistic in plteobs and at or above it in pgteobs. It also holds the number of simulations as times, the name of the statistic as statistic, and the controls that the test used as control.

See also

Other models: control_mrqap(), diagnose_confusion(), other_results, play_diffusions(), print.netreg_lm(), regression, specify, specify_terms, terms_mrqap, test_fit, test_parameter()

Examples

marvel_friends <- fict_marvel |> to_uniplex("relationship") |> 
  to_unsigned() |> to_giant() |> 
  to_subgraph(PowerOrigin == "Human")
(cugtest <- test_random(marvel_friends, net_by_heterophily, attribute = "Attractive",
   times = 200))
#> # CUG test of net_by_heterophily()
#> 
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   statistic null.mean null.sd p.lower p.upper
#>       <dbl>     <dbl>   <dbl> <chr>   <chr>  
#> 1    -0.857    -0.612  0.0916 0.005   0.995  
#> 
#> # Null: 200 random networks with the same size and density.
# plot(cugtest)
# (qaptest <- test_permutation(marvel_friends, 
#                 net_by_heterophily, attribute = "Attractive",
#                 times = 200))
# plot(qaptest)
